title: Duo Dark
description: A two-tone dark mode GUI pack with colored accents.
body:
Howdy y'all,

This is the successor of my [Moon Fall SMP - Dark Mode](https://modrinth.com/project/ZzQBfrbV) resource pack!

Since it was originally made for a specific server that is now depreciated, I figured I'd make a standard version instead of repurposing that project page. I am in the process of reworking a few textures and formatting within the pack, so some things may seem out of place while it is in **beta**.

Below are other resources used to make Duo Dark:
- Better Fonts x32 - Colonel_Gerdauf
  - https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-fonts
    - Duo Dark includes an edited version.

Be sure to also check out my other resource pack [Ecoasis Interface](https://modrinth.com/project/FJkemAan)!
